label: D1 after a reward, late in the episode (trial >= ~80), when the agent is about to choose a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), and almost only when the reward input is 1 (99.5% of mass). It never fires before episode trial ~60, and its rate climbs steeply toward the end of the episode (74% of mass is in trials 90-99). It also lines up with low model value (the value falls late in the episode). It is strongly biased toward a1/S1: 93% of mass falls where the upcoming choice is a1, and it is rare when S2 is good. Magnitude builds up over runs of consecutive rewarded a1 trials and peaks near the end of the episode. Requiring the previous trial to be rewarded as well raised F1 only slightly (0.73 vs 0.72), so I left it out. The recorded predicate uses the agent own upcoming choice (action at D1), which is allowed. The closest predicate with only observed variables, prev_action == 1 in place of action == 1, scores F1 0.61 / mass recall 0.73 on dev; good == 1 scores F1 0.63. Main errors: false positives at early-ramp or first-after-a-loss rewarded D1 steps, and weak activations on a2 trials.
